meta.source: 311 Service Requests from 2010 to Present (NYC Open Data, erm2-nwe9), accessed 2026-07-02; populations: 2020 decennial census

strands.label: Noise
strands.desc: Loud music, parties, shouting and engine noise from homes, streets, businesses, vehicles and parks. Excludes helicopter noise.

strands.label: Street homelessness
strands.desc: Reports of encampments and requests for outreach to homeless individuals in public spaces.

strands.label: Rats and rodents
strands.desc: Rat and mouse sightings and conditions attracting rodents.

strands.label: Dirty streets
strands.desc: Litter, filthy sidewalks and overflowing public litter baskets. Excludes missed trash collection, which is a service failure rather than observed street conditions.

strands.label: Illegal dumping
strands.desc: Trash, debris or bulk items dumped illegally in public spaces or lots.

strands.label: Graffiti
strands.desc: Graffiti reported on buildings and public property.

strands.label: Abandoned vehicles
strands.desc: Cars left on streets without plates or in derelict condition, reported to police and sanitation.

strands.label: Public drug and alcohol use
strands.desc: Reported drug activity, public drinking and public urination. Public urination generates few 311 calls and is likely undercounted.

strands.label: Panhandling
strands.desc: Reports of panhandling. Panhandling itself is legal; 311 accepts reports about aggressive or traffic-obstructing solicitation.

strands.label: Streets in disrepair
strands.desc: Potholes, cave-ins, broken pavement and damaged sidewalks — physical decay of the streetscape.
